youtube_description:
No-cost EMI can hide costs: the cash discount may be removed, a processing fee may apply, and GST is charged on the interest part. And your next 6 salaries are pre-booked.

Rule: if you can't buy it in cash twice, don't buy it on EMI even once. General info, not financial advice.
